decisive_items: a well-defined, multilobulated, mildly echogenic swelling
lying within the fourth extensor tendon compartment adjacent to the extensor indicis proprius tendon
the working diagnosis was a giant‐cell tumor of the tendon sheath
response.rationale: The location, description, and ultrasound findings of the mass are consistent with a giant cell tumor of the tendon sheath, and there are no contradicting spans or alternative diagnoses provided.
